metadata.purpose: Deprecated multicast(() => new Subject(), selector) with two branches set up before connecting one original source.

conditions: One source subscription per selected-result subscription, despite two consumers of the shared Subject.
The selected output is subscribed before the source is acquired, including synchronous producers.
A factory creates a fresh Subject for every output subscription; a fixed Subject instance has different reuse semantics and is out of scope.

scope.parameters: Deprecated subjectFactory plus selector overload. Factory returns fresh plain Subject; selector merges shared$ twice.
scope.callbacks: Selector construction modeled as a synchronous correlated callback; no source side effect before selected subscription.
scope.time: No scheduler or timer. Source dictates the timing; one source next causes two same-moment selected outputs.
scope.reentrancy: Synchronous source notifications after completed selector setup are supported; arbitrary selector reentry and synchronous selected-result termination are excluded.
exclusions: Subject instance reuse, selector-less ConnectableObservable.connect/refCount, ReplaySubject/BehaviorSubject/AsyncSubject, custom connector and arbitrary selectors.
Synchronous selected-result early termination, observer reentrancy and throwing finalizers.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Create Subject, call selector, subscribe selected output, then connect original source.

ownership.sharing: Within one selected-result subscription, one Subject multicasts a single source connection to two selected branches. Separate result subscriptions get separate Subjects.
ownership.reset: New Subject and selected subscriptions for each fresh output subscription.

resources.owner: one shared source connection per selected result

dispatch.actionSemantics: Subscribe selected Observable before subscribing producer; each producer next broadcasts same payload into both registered branches.
cancellationCheckpoints: After selector setup; between source notifications.
Release selected subscriptions and original source on termination.

rules.explanation: Both selected branches listen to the multicast Subject before a synchronous source can emit.
No source is connected when selector construction fails.
Both branches receive the same object without cloning; selector merge emits two output notifications.
Completion propagates through the configured selected stream, not as a second output completion.
The original error identity is preserved; no values are emitted after termination.
